name: Main version
postCreateCommand:
sudo echo -e "host all all ::1/128 trust
$(sudo cat /etc/postgresql/16/main/pg_hba.conf)" > pg_hba.conf && sudo mv pg_hba.conf /etc/postgresql/16/main/pg_hba.conf && sudo psql -c "ALTER USER postgres PASSWORD 'postgres';" && yarn
postAttachCommand: sudo service postgresql start && cp -n .env.example .env && code .env && yarn
